audit_protocol_delta.reason: Defended content is not rewritten for cosmetic churn.

carry_forward_constraints: S42 must not treat S41 or CP-N4-A as passed. S41 is REPAIR_REQUIRED with 40 findings; the authoritative CP-N4-A gate is S43, while S39/CF-3 and S40 debt remain active.

S42 security/privacy/schema work must sit on an actual FastAPI/Pydantic/TestClient contract. Hand-written dictionaries, printed booleans and the current QLoRA playground are not evidence for S41 API behavior.

Preserve upstream artifact lineage across every request/job/evidence response: actor/context, cutoff/as-of, raw/effective snapshot/hash, ER/graph/feature/model/policy versions, human decision and evidence references remain reconstructible.

Carry S41 HTTP regressions: unknown path is 404, known path with unsupported method is 405 with allowed methods, create semantics use 201 and a coherent resource location when applicable, and validation errors are distinct from routing errors.

Idempotency must remain scoped by tenant/client + operation + key, store an immutable canonical request fingerprint and response, and survive duplicate/concurrent requests plus process/store reopen through an atomic durable claim. Mutable in-memory dict state is invalid evidence.

Keyset pagination must validate size/cursor, use a unique immutable ordering/tie-break and bind cursor to filters/as-of context. Unknown/stale/tampered cursors fail explicitly rather than pretending to be end-of-data.

Versioning does not itself guarantee compatibility. Freeze an old v1 consumer and test candidate schemas/behavior for requiredness, types, enum evolution, error contracts, semantics, ordering/pagination and operational limits.
Dependency injection and bounded-context boundaries require executable module/port/adapter contract tests. domain_imports_http=False or a Protocol shape alone is not architecture evidence.

Request validation must use typed/range/extra-field policies and prove invalid requests cannot reach the domain or mutate state. Response schemas/OpenAPI/errors must be generated and tested against runtime behavior.

Keep CPU isolation and durability as separate dimensions. Durable jobs must be committed to a persistent queue/store before response and survive reopen; process-local BackgroundTasks/list queues do not satisfy recovery requirements inherited from S38.
Problem Details must distinguish RFC 9457 standard members from service extensions such as trace_id, use the appropriate media type when implemented, and remain free of stack/PII/internal keys.

Timeout/lifecycle evidence must execute real local timeouts/cancellation and verify resource cleanup. Numeric comparisons or ['startup','shutdown'] literals are not evidence; reject negative/nonfinite budget inputs.

Carry pytest systematically with unit, HTTP contract/TestClient and controlled integration layers. Do not gate on unit>=contract>=integration counts; seed actual domain, HTTP and adapter defects and verify each is caught at the cheapest correct layer.

Rate limiting must have a real identity and time window/refill/reset plus concurrency-safe state and valid nonnegative inputs. 429 may expose a Retry-After header consistent with the limiter window; a pure used>limit function is not a rate limiter.
Observability must propagate trace_id and span_id across request -> durable job -> result. A correlation string or trace_id alone is not a trace.
Privacy gates must use allowlisted/minimized response/error/log/trace schemas and adversarial nested/value tests; banning only top-level keys named email/dni/secret does not prove no PII.
Use reserved synthetic domains such as example.com/.test and never reintroduce example.pe in S42 examples.

Keep no-autofraud, abstention, reviewer routing and appeal semantics intact through S42 security schemas; auth/security hardening may not collapse scores/evidence into automatic guilt, fraud or relationship conclusions.

Deprecation/schema migration in S42 must name affected consumers, owner, support status, migration path, removal condition/date and rollback evidence; labels or version headers alone are insufficient.
Inherited S26-S41 debt remains active. Security wrappers cannot retroactively validate broken data, ER, fairness, resilience, CF-3, architecture or API-contract evidence.
